question: Which Feishu newline branch should maintainers treat as canonical before any of the linked fixes lands?
rationale: This PR is a focused but incomplete candidate, while a sibling branch has stronger proof but is currently conflicting, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent branch strategy.

options.title: Prefer a repaired proof-positive sibling

options.title: Keep this branch as candidate
